first_step_test: A soft squat pouch body with an open gathered top fixes the silhouette and leaves room for the cord channel and hanging tassels.

source.notes: Six-panel handmade pencil contact sheet; review saved sheet and crops before approval.

final_elements.name: pouch body
final_elements.description: A squat rounded pouch body with a softly flattened bottom and open top.

final_elements.name: gathered neck
final_elements.description: Two short inward shoulders pinch into the gathered opening.

final_elements.name: top opening
final_elements.description: A narrow curved opening joins the gathered shoulders.

final_elements.name: cord channel
final_elements.description: Two shallow parallel arcs run around the upper pouch below the opening.

final_elements.name: left cord
final_elements.description: One loose cord emerges from the left channel opening and hangs down.

final_elements.name: right cord
final_elements.description: One loose cord emerges from the right channel opening and hangs down.

final_elements.name: left tassel
final_elements.description: A small tapered tassel ends the left cord.

final_elements.name: right tassel
final_elements.description: A small tapered tassel ends the right cord.

final_elements.name: center seam
final_elements.description: A short broken vertical seam sits on the front center.

final_elements.name: two lower folds
final_elements.description: Two separate light folds rise from the bottom corners.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop is a centered squat pouch body with a flattened base and a deliberate top gap; the gap gives beginners clear endpoints for the gathered opening.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Every adjacent saved JPG was compared at readable size. The lower body, upper shoulder anchors, channel arcs, two hanging cords and two tassels persist. The final frame shades existing fabric with visible pencil grain. There are no temporary guides, unexplained removals, or moved landmarks.

transitions.observed_addition: The squat pouch body and flattened bottom stay fixed; two inward gathered shoulders and a narrow curved opening join the two reserved top endpoints.
transitions.instruction_match: The opening instruction joins the two original upper ends without relocating the pouch.

transitions.observed_addition: The body, both shoulders and top opening stay in place; two shallow parallel arcs add the cord channel below the opening.
transitions.instruction_match: The channel instruction places its two arcs between the existing upper shoulders.

transitions.observed_addition: The same body, opening and channel remain; one cord leaves each side and ends in one separate tapered tassel. Exactly two cords and two tassels are visible.
transitions.instruction_match: The cord instruction names both side exits and the two tassel endings.

transitions.observed_addition: Both cords and tassels retain their anchors; a short broken center seam and one set of light folds at each bottom corner appear inside the body.
transitions.instruction_match: The fold instruction locates the center seam and the two lower corner fold groups.

transitions.observed_addition: All pouch contours, two cords, two tassels, center seam and lower folds remain; graphite and warm ochre darken only established fabric and tassels.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction shades existing forms without introducing a structural line.
